subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Compares two collections: more, fewer or the same

show.line: Look at the two nests. This nest has more eggs. That nest has fewer eggs.

rounds.praise: Yes! Five is more than two.
Yes! Three is fewer than seven.

rounds.prompt: Which two baskets have the same number of flowers?
rounds.praise: Yes! Four and four. The same!

rounds.prompt: Six eggs here and four eggs there. Which has more? Say six or four.
Count the flowers in the pot with more flowers.

hints: Count each group. The bigger number is more.
Match them one by one. The group with some left over has more.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Three birds here. Five birds there.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Five is more than three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count. One, two, three. One, two, three, four, five. Five is more!

parent_line: Can tell which group has more, fewer or the same.
